description: datacarto.geopal.org: telecommunications datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by datacarto.geopal.org. Coverage: the area served by datacarto.geopal.org. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about telecommunications; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Couverture 4G - 2019 T3 - ORF Opérateur Orange France; Couverture 4G - 2019 T3 - BYT Opérateur Bouygues Telecom; Couverture 4G - 2019 T3 - SFR Opérateur SFR; Couverture 4G - 2019 T3 - FRM Opérateur Free Mobile. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
